Description: Violations regarding data controllers/processors obligations; certification bodies; monitoring bodies. (e.g. Failing to appoint a DPO or conduct a DPIA).
Violations of basic principles for processing (including consent); data subjects' rights; transfers to third countries. (e.g. Processing data without consent or failing to delete data when asked).
Non-compliance with an order previously issued by the Supervisory Authority.
Member states may impose their own criminal penalties for severe data theft or misuse beyond administrative fines.
